description: This file defines a 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within a testing or automation framework, including event handling, request/response logging, snapshot capturing, and modal/dialog management.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing events, requests, responses, dialogs, snapshots, and console logs.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message with type, timestamp, text, and a string representation.

methods.name: messageToConsoleMessage
methods.description: Converts a playwright.ConsoleMessage to a ConsoleMessage object.

methods.name: pageErrorToConsoleMessage
methods.description: Converts a page error or value to a ConsoleMessage object.

methods.name: renderModalStates
methods.description: Renders modal states into a list of descriptive strings.

methods.name: shouldIncludeMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message of a certain type should be included based on threshold level.

methods.name: consoleLevelForMessageType
methods.description: Maps a console message type to a severity level.
